title: Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements Distribution Channel Terms for Retroactive Claims
content:
**Terms.** On a Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements agreement, the booking channel of a claimed ticket — as recorded on the ticket in Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand — sets the claim share of a retroactive points claim. A ticket booked through a channel outside the tier's eligible booking channels may still be claimed, at the outside-channel claim share.

| Booking channel of the claimed ticket | Claim share kept |
|---|---|
| a channel outside the tier's eligible booking channels | 50 percent |
| the Crestline app or the Crestline website, where that channel is eligible for the tier | 90 percent |
| any other eligible channel | 100 percent, the whole claim |

**How the share acts.** The shared claim points are the uplifted claim points — the claim points after any uplift — multiplied by the claim share and divided by one hundred, rounded down to the whole point.

### Channel matrix by tier

| Tier | Crestline website or Crestline app | Corporate booking tool | Travel agency | Reservations call center | Airport counter |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Business Connect | 90 | 50 | 50 | 50 | 50 |
| Crestline Business Connect Plus | 90 | 100 | 50 | 50 | 50 |
| Crestline Corporate Select | 50 | 100 | 100 | 100 | 50 |
| Crestline Corporate Preferred | 50 | 100 | 100 | 100 | 50 |
| Crestline Corporate Premier | 50 | 100 | 100 | 100 | 50 |
| Crestline Corporate Strategic | 50 | 100 | 100 | 100 | 50 |

The matrix follows from each tier's eligible booking channels: the Crestline website and the Crestline app for Crestline Business Connect; those two and the corporate booking tool for Crestline Business Connect Plus; the corporate booking tool, a travel agency and the reservations call center for every Corporate tier.

### Questions on the terms

**A Crestline Corporate Premier company claims a ticket bought on the Crestline app. What share is kept?** The app is not an eligible channel for that tier, so the ticket is claimed at 50 percent.

**What do 756 uplifted claim points become at 90 percent? (hypothetical)** 756 multiplied by 90 and divided by one hundred is 680.4, rounded down to 680.
